business_name: Philips Sonicare HX3351/02 Xtreme Battery Operated Toothbrush
product_title: Philips Sonicare HX3351/02 Xtreme Battery Operated Toothbrush
review_text:
This product is good while it lasts; it'll clean your teeth better than almost anything out there (unless you have tartar, then you'll need something with a bit more power) and stimulate your gums.  However, having autopsied this model, I am convinced that it was engineered to fail under typical conditions after a time, perhaps to motivate the purchase of a more expensive model, which will itself become useless when the irreplaceable batteries go out.

The first one I bought lasted a year, and even that long only after I learned that you have to plug the two holes in the back of the battery compartment to prevent the corrosion from taking place.  By the end, batteries were lasting one week tops, at 2x use per day.  I also learned that you have to hit it against hard objects when it won't turn on and sometimes then it'll go.  You also need to scrape off any rust from the battery contacts occasionally.

Knowing these quirks, I bought another one and immediately plugged up the holes in the back and put tape around the battery cap.  However, it has now lasted only a month.  There's no rust or corrosion to speak of, however, it just doesn't turn on anymore.

Today I autopsied the first sonicare to see why it had failed (the new one is still on warranty).  In taking it apart, it's clear that most of your money goes into buying a tank-like shell around the $1 worth of electronics.  This would be a good thing, if there were not two gaping holes in the battery cap that let water in anyway and the shoddy rubber seal.  After taking it apart, it's clear why the corrosion so quickly leads the failure.  They protect everything on the circuit-board from corrosion by putting glue over it, except the battery contacts, and the contacts and wires that lead to the solenoid coil (that makes the brush vibrate).  The contacts that lead to the solenoid and the battery contacts are also strategically located next to each other on the circuit board, so they can corrode together quickly using any moisture from the adjacent battery-terminal holes, while the non-essentials like the timer are located on the other side of the board and completely sealed off from the ambient air by glue.  This also explains why hitting it sometimes allows it to start; you're shaking some of the corrosion loose.

The switch is also of questionable design, being nothing more than a paper-thin piece of plastic with some kind ring on it that's slightly more conductive than the plastic.

If the replacement that I get out of the warranty fails, I think I'll try a cybersonic or an oral-b; hopefully their teams of engineers weren't paid to make something less reliable than a politician.

Why can't they make a sonic toothbrush with no batteries, that plugs into the wall, and lasts a lifetime?  Or just quit making these to fail so readily?

review_text:
I bought this not knowing what to really expect as this was my first electric shaving machine. Surprisingly, the shave is as good as my regular razor blade. My skin felt really smooth after, plus there were no nicks (the kind you get with regular shaving).

Cleaning the thing is really easy. You just run hot water over the circular blades and air dry.

Battery charging is done in a hour's time.

The unit is very light and comes with a stand and a travel case. It is a well-designed product.

If you find this on sale, I would recommend it.

review_title: Huge itchy bumps develop into huge itchy pimples
review_text:
There's something in this mask that causes my forehead (mostly but not exclusively my forehead) to break out in large red itchy bumps.  I've tested it six or seven times to make sure it couldn't be something else coincidentally causing those bumps and it's definitely this product.  I use it in the morning and by that afternoon the bumps/itchiness have started.

I use quite a few different mud masks without issue.  I have another brand of manuka honey mask...no problems.  There's either something in this particular mud that disagrees with me or else the combination of the two ingredients seriously aggravates my skin.

The mask goes on well and feels OK while it's on the face but I've never noticed any good reaction to say that its effectiveness is impressive.  It's a mud mask.  Unfortunately for me, it's a mud mask that isn't destined to be used.

product_title: FLOSSCARD (10 Pack) 12 Yards of Dental Floss in a Credit Card Shaped Dispenser
review_title: If you used to Oral-B Glide floss, you would not like this!
review_text:
Product reviews on Amazon are something I always rely upon to make my purchase decision. Before buying this brand of floss, which was first time for my family (We usually buy Oral-B Glide floss at Costco), the straight 5-star reviews caught my attention so I thought this must be really good stuff. But as it turned out, this is nothing near the dental floss we expected - the line is too thin to hold on to; there is no waxing so moving in and out of the teeth gap is frustrating, not to mention the effectiveness of cleaning stuff in there. After a few attempts, we gave up using it and now there are 99% of unused packets. If anyone has really used this brand of floss and likes it, please let me know, so I can send them to you with no charge (but please send a prepaid return envelope). Hate to see the "5-star" stuff got wasted like this!

After all, even though the Glide floss quality has somehow gone down in recent years (the line become easier to break, which wasn't the case a few years back), it is still 10 times better. So I guess we have to stick with Oral-B Glide floss and pray they will improve their outsourcing process and bring the Glide quality back to where it was before outsourcing production to some foreign place where they don't give a damn to Americans' teeth.

Sorry, Flosscard maker and vendor, I have to do this to somewhat bring the review ranking to reality so none will be misguided again and make the same mistake we did. I know there are many Glide floss users out there who become unsatisfied with the worsening of Glide floss quality in recent years, especially with the tendency to break prematurely, and want to try something else. I was one of those and now I am here to tell you, my adventure has failed.

review_title: I can honestly say most of these poor reviews are BS
review_text:
I'm a nail tech, and I can honestly say most of these poor reviews are BS. The fact that they're in opaque plastic bottles instead of glass is a good and necessary thing. Gel cures with uv. Even from the sun, ladies. No, they don't come with a swatch or names. They're off brand and you're supposed to make your own swatch. Duh. And yes they're sticky. So is ALL gel. Amateur complaints. However, I haven't yet received mine in the mail. I will reevaluate once I've tried them out.

***edit as of 9-20-14
So I received the product in the mail. And honestly I'm not disappointed. When I went to update this I saw 2 new reviews saying buyer beware this product does not cure with UV. I panicked a little bit and tested it out on my thumb nail. I first tried curing with LED and it did not work. But hey that's alright. Lots of gels don't cure with an LED light. So then I tried it with UV and it did cure. I used my own gel polish base coat first and cured that completely. Then I used 2 layers of number 07 and cured both layers for 2 minutes each. They cured like a charm. And I topped it off with my gelish top coat. I didn't encounter any more problems. However. My one complaint is the pot is much shallower than it looks. There is only a little bit of product in each pot. Maybe 2-5 full sets of gel worth. But again. I'm still not disappointment. I spent around a dollar on each pot of color. The colors are nice. I'm pretty stoked to try them all.

business_name: Dashing Diva Nail Guard Protective Strips, 54 ct
product_title: Dashing Diva Nail Guard Protective Strips, 54 ct
review_title: Works GREAT! I Am Excited About These - they stick really, really good and easy!
review_text:
These are perfect for doing your own Gel nails at home. They were really, really easy to apply and seem strong. So far so good. I am on day 3 with these Guards under my OPI Gelcolor and excited about them. YAY! no more damaged nails!  I didn’t have to use OPI bondAid with them. I only used the nail Guard on my bare nails but I did make sure there was no residue or dust on my nails before applying the Guard, I just applied 1 basecoat, 2 gelcolor and  1 top coat on top of the nail Guards.

They feel really strong, protected and stable. I’ve been doing dishes and everything....No peeling... No lifting.. No chipping. My nails still look as good as new! You can’t tell at all that the Nail Guards are under my gelcolor. I can finally grow my nails out without all the torture in taking gel or tips off and no more sanding down. Yep, supposedly you can use these under acrylic or gel TIPs too! maybe even tips that you glue on? that’s amazing! but I am trying Gelcolor first. We’ll see, I will update in two weeks but so far so good. There are youtube videos demonstrating how easy it is to take them off without any damage... These are amazing. Revolutionary indeed! I will update in weeks.

UPDATE: I LOVE THESE GUARDS.... that being said the truth is these lasted for exactly 2 weeks. I think I could of gotten longer if I capped my tips better with gel  because the edge of my nail tips were the first area to start showing wear and ever so sightly the guards at the tip started to peel (2 weeks). It was soo easy to take the Guards and GelColor off, in a matter of a few minutes.  My natural nail is perfect after taking them off... no damage, no dryness, no staining, no brittleness. My tips were white and not stained and my nail beds were a normal pink and best of all they have grown out healthy and are my own nails,  YAY!!!  I will never need fake tips again. I am sooo excite how well these worked.  Honestly they never looked so good after taking off any nail color that includes plain nail polish which would stain my nails and dry out from nail polish remover. The bond of these shields sticks very well and strong. Also anyone having trouble with gel sticking to there natural nails because of their own natural nail chemistry.... this maybe be a great solution for you.

UPDATE: Amazing! I have figured out the PERFECT combination to make them last longer then 2 weeks, actually they last  until I am ready to remove. Here’s what I do... I prep my nails using opi nas99 and opi bondaid then I apply the Nail guards, then I apply 2 thin coats of HARD gel I used iBD hard gel (nail builder) right over the Nail Guards, cap the end of the nails well, then I apply 2 coats of color gel (GelColor) and then 1 or 2 coats of OPI Top coat the OPI Top Coat  is stronger then the gelcolor so I usually put 2 coats of top top but 1 is fine, it just depends on what you like, I  like my nails supper glossy, a little thicker, this combination makes them super strong. Caping the NailGuard on the end with iBD Hard gel is the secret to gelcolor lasting longer. This combination last for weeks on end without any peeling or chipping. My nails are now super strong and protected, are healthier,  my manicure stays for weeks on end and best of all it easily comes off when I am ready to take it off with no damage. The only thing is I have to use my regular UV light for the Hard gel (180 sec ea coat of hard gel) to cure and I use my LED OPI Light (30 sec ea coat) for my Gelcolor to cure but it’s 100% worth it!

review_text:

I contacted Pure Body Naturals about exchanging for an undamaged product they responded immediately with a coupon code for a brand new bottle. After one use my hair is softer and noticeably less frizzy even after blowing drying and styling.  Also, since I only wash my hair a few times per week and this shampoo cleans beautifully without stripping my hair.  I highly recommend this shampoo!

product_title: SDB Brush Hair Straightener,Anion Hair Care, Anti Scald,Instant Magic Silky Straight Hair Styling,Massage Straightening Irons, Detangling Hair Brush,Zero Damage Pink
review_title: Wow, I like it! It really does work with a little effort!
review_text:
I was hesitant to buy one of these because I already have a cabinet full of failed beauty products that I don't use, however my daughter kept asking for one of these straightening brushes to see if it would work on her naturally, thick and curly hair. I am very pleased to report that it really does work! My daughter is bi-racial, and her hair is very unruly sometimes. Most days it is a job in itself just to get her hair brushed. The wonderful feature of this brush is that you can use it directly after a blow dry to straighten the hair even further. It is also very easy to handle so my teenage daughter was able to use this by herself without any burns or accidents.

Before you ask where the before picture is, my daughter was not open to having her wild and crazy hair all over the internet, so we had to skip that picture, but I did include an after picture to show how smooth and silky her hair turned out after using this brush. Features include a long enough cord that you can maneuver around a bit. The temperature controls go from a low of about 330 F to a high of about 450 F, which I think is enough for most hair types without burning the hair. Another great feature is that you are not pulling the hair as much as you have to when you are using a flat iron, so there is a lot less pressure on the hair. Overall, great tool to have! Makes your life a little bit easier and you can breeze through straightening the hair a lot faster. I did receive this item at a discounted rate in exchange for my honest and unbiased review, however that has no bearing on my views and opinions.

review_text: I love this system. I have an older unit and it's worked for years. I have extremely sensitive and somewhat crooked teeth, so other whitening devices either hurt really bad and/or don't stay on (strips). Glo DOES NOT HURT. I cannot stress that enough. The only time I've had any issues is when I've accidentally gotten some of the gel on my gums. It'll hurt during the session and turn white but go away by the next morning. However, just use a Q-tip to wipe off any gel that gets on your gums and you'll never have an issue. My teeth are definitely on the whiter side to begin with, but with Glo, twice I've gotten to the whitest natural shade possible, B1, before getting permanent crowns (so the dentist has taken my shade and told me I'm B1). Would highly recommend.

review_text:
I wasn't sure what to expect from these compressed facial masks in terms of quality, as reviews were across the board. But, they far exceeded my needs and expectations!
They are about the size of three dimes stacked, and are embossed with little flowers on top, which is really just a pretty presentation.
They expand easily with moisture, I mixed up my own serum solution with essential oil, and it was easy to soak and unfold. I worried I would have to be super delicate so as not to tear the paper, but these are more of a fabric than tissue.
In fact, I opened one up to test it's durability. I used some warm water, added some dish soap and went to town scrubbing my basin. No tears, no ripping, no holes. (In fact it cleaned up really well). I used some extra pulling pressure on the cut parts, mouth, eyes chin, and as expected had tears and stretching happen, but that was with abnormal applied pressure.
They didn't smell, they didn't feel weird, and they fit great. For the relaxing usage of a home facial these little compact masks are perfect. I know exactly what I'm putting on my face.

review_title: I don’t like the scent but it works well
review_text:
I ordered this because I’m tired of using big-box store hair gel.

I miss using pomade style products and for the few dollars I used to save, 2020 has taught me to treat myself to the small luxuries in life.

Overall, you get A LOT of product in this jar.
I like the texture and the hold.

I spike up my hair a little and this worked well for that.

My problem, and mind you it’s MY problem not the product; is I personally don’t like the smell. It’s like a hairdresser perfume like scent. Very much like it’s got some cologne mixed into it.

You can smell the cologne through the shipping bag.

Overall while I don’t like the scent I absolutely appreciate the quantity provided. The value is definitely there.

review_title: Love the design. Room for improvement with major issues
review_text:
I love how this looks but I cannot recommend it.

There are 2 major negatives. First, the water reservoir is too small. I need to refill it before I'm finished. Second, the water reservoir is not removable. You cannot take it off to clean or dry. After using it, there's always a little bit of water left inside. After months of use, this has the potential to get nasty. I live in a dry climate and leave the small refill door open when not using to help it dry out so it's been OK for me.

Another side effect of not being able to remove the reservoir is the mold that develops between the reservoir and the flosser body. There is a small gap between the two parts and water will get in there. After a year or more, there will be mold. The image is after 16 months of daily use

If these 2 issues were fixed, this product would be close to perfect.

I do see the product description says, "The full-open water tank design allows water tank to be removed and cleaned inside easily. You can keep the reservoir dry after every use without worrying about the mold breeding." Either this is a lie or they changed the design since my purchase. If the design has changed, the images don't show it.

A quick search on Amazon shows a similarly designed flosser with a larger and removable reservoir and it's cheaper.

review_title: Nice glass bottles with spray attachment
review_text:
Very nice-looking and easy to use glass bottles. You can really use these for an assortment of things. I got them mainly to put in hand sanitizers so that I can keep them in my purse, in my car, and give them out to family members. What I did was just poured out previously purchased hand sanitizers into these smaller bottles.

The package comes with a small funnel and labels but since I'm currently using them just for hand sanitizers, I didn't really need the labels. I do plan on using these bottles for other things but will wait a bit on that.

The glass is a nice thick material and the amber color helps keep the ingredients inside protected from changing colors and composition.

I recommend this if you're going to transfer liquid from larger bottles into these smaller ones. I would assume if you filled them to the top, the hand sanitizers could last up to a month or so.

review_text:
Now that masks are the new fashion accessory I've discovered that not all masks fit the same. There's definitely a difference in how they fit over your nose and mouth. My favorite mask, which is stretchy, isn't always practical. I'm not fond of cloth masks because of how they sit on my face, but these brackets actually make them comfortable.

Basically, I put the bracket inside a double-layer mask. This works great to keep the bracket from pinching your face while at the same time keeping the mask a little bit further away. The difference in comfort is significant, and it's very easy to forget you're wearing a mask with one of these on.

That said, you still need to wash it,and sliding these brackets in and out of a double-layer mask isn't easy. But if you're willing to put in the effort in a mask that you'll wear all day, it's definitely more comfortable.

review_title: Ideal make-up when you are on the go
review_text:
This makeup is very different than any other I have used in terms of how it is stored and applied; however, I really, really like it.
If you are someone who travels or likes to touch up your foundation throughout the day, this might well be the perfect makeup for you.
It comes in a very well designed compact that holds the liquid foundation in a sponge in its own closed compartment.
The applicator sponge sits atop the cover to that compartment, so the entire thing is spill proof and well protected.

Applying the makeup I found that it blended very well using the included applicator sponge.
The coverage level is medium, evening out skin tone and obscuring imperfections, but not covering major discoloration.
Put another way, if you have a mole or blemish you really want to cover up, you would probably still want to use a spot corrector.

The foundation itself has a matte finish with a nice feel.
I've found I can wear it on its own or with a powder finish.

Color matches are always tricky, particularly online; however, I managed to get a pretty great one.
Unless I have been getting a lot of sun, my skin is pretty pale.
I'm basically one step up from ivory skin, which this Beige Color blended with extremely well.

To show how well it blends and how matte the finish is, I applied it onto one half of my inner forearm, then took photos in two different light settings.
In the photos, the bottom half of my forearm has the foundation on it, but it leaves almost no line and no shine.

As far as staying power is concerned, I would rate this is above average.
It stayed on well for me all day when I was not sweating, but would come off a little on anything that directly rubbed against my skin.
I also found this to be a gentle foundation that did not irritate my skin.

I can happily recommend this foundation compact.
I was truly pleased with both the design of the dispenser, which makes it perfectly portable, and with the performance of the makeup itself.

review_title: Good purple DYE DEPOSITING shampoo and conditioner
review_text:
This shampoo smells like the stuff often used when I’m at the salon- very fresh and clean, with a very mild hint of floral. Be aware this is a purple color depositing shampoo. Meaning, you are literally depositing small amounts of purple dye to your hair when you shampoo and condition. The purple dye color cancels out brassy orange colors that develop on blond and silver hair. You should not use this as a daily/maintenance shampoo. Depending on your hair, this (or any purple shampoo) could dye your hair a cotton candy purple (I had it happen with another brand that my friend had imported from Eastern Europe). With this shampoo, my first wash I did not notice any difference in my hair, but the second wash there was a definite difference. It’s not terribly noticeable in my photo, but there is a slight purple sheen to my silver/greys. My hair felt soft after and was manageable.
Another thing to be aware, this product is made in China. Label says “Made in PRC”, which is short for People’s Republic of China. Current price is $19.95, which is good for a purple shampoo and conditioner that works of this size.

review_text: I have had difficulty with purple shampoo in the past as it would leave my hair purple in appearance just with the short amount of time it takes to do one shampoo. I use the length of the inside of my middle finger as far as amount, just squirt it out along the finger, rub hands together and then work well into all of the wet hair. I am going through the process of "grey blending" my hair and there are still blonde highlights that I need to tone down to blend in better with the grey that is becoming quite prevalent from month to month.  Try it, you will like it!!

I hope they continue selling this because I have found my foundation.
Love the bag and the primer, the sponges not so much.

review_title: DO NOT BUY IF YOU CALUE YOUR EYELIDS
review_text:
TDLR: Don’t buy, potential allergic reactions and impossible to remove.

I am a newbie when it comes to false eyelashes. These were my first pair and I thought to myself Mavericks seemed easier than glue for my first try of things. My mistake.

The eyeliner does NOT come off. It just doesn’t. I’ve tried everything. I used the product they gave me with warm water, my own makeup remover, micellar water…NOTHING! I got the bulk of it yeah, but there’s still a ton in my lash line. It’s like you’re supposed to use your nail to just scratch it off? I’m not going to do that. It’s just like no amount of gentle wiping and rubbing is doing anything. Not sure how long it’s going to stay out, at this point.

And as an added bonus? I think I’m allergic to the product. I tested it on my hand first, but my right eyelid is swelling a bit. Not sure if it’s from trying to get the product off (I didn’t scrub hard or anything, and just used cotton wipes) or the product itself. I took some allergy meds and am applying a cold compress now. Trying to catch it fast and monitor it.

Save yourself the money. Do not buy this. It’s not worth the effort. Because even if you don’t have an allergic reaction, I’d bet you’re still going to struggle getting this eyeliner off and that’s not worth the struggle. But something else.

review_title: Nice small but angled tip. Little dry so need to press a little harder, but stays put well
review_text:
I usually like micro brow pencils with really small pointed tips rather than angled tips. Usually angled tips are thicker than I like, but I do like how quickly they fill brows. This is the perfect combo of both you get a thin, precise tip that’s angled. I feel like the formula is drier than I usually like. I usually go for creamier brow pencils, but I like the tip and as long as you press a little harder it works well. It also stays in place really well.

Overall, I think this is a really nice brow pencil. If you’re like me and usually like the micro brow pencils but like how quick angled tips fill in the brows, I think you’d like this if you don’t mind that it isn’t creamy and you need to press a little harder.

review_title: Not cakey or powdery looking on the face
review_text:
I have had the opportunity to try quite a few By Terry brand products and they have been really hit or miss for me. Basically I either love them or think they are horrible. But I’m happy to say that this By Terry Hyaluronic Pressed Hydra-Powder definitely falls in the former category!

This pressed powder comes in a cute case that seams decently solid and pretty well made. The powder was securely pressed when manufacturing, so there wasn’t any loose powder rolling around inside.

As far as how well it works, I love it! The powder doesn’t kick up a whole lot, yet you still get a good bit on your brush. It doesn’t leave my face looking at all cakey or powdery, but it does take the shine away and lasts for most of the day. I do have to reapply sometimes if it’s a really long day, but not a huge deal. Would definitely recommend this and would definitely purchase in the future.

5 stars

review_text:
This moisturizer is a light tan color and has a kind of gel texture. It smells a little medicinal and comes in a jar. I get it out with a cotton swab to try to keep it from getting germy from my fingers. My skin is dry/combo, aging, dehydrated and acne-prone. I mostly need help on my cheeks this time of year, so that's where I've been using it.

I spread this on my cheeks and it immediately leaves a slight cooling sensation. It takes a while for it to soak in/dry down completely and it feels a bit tacky until then. Once the tackiness is gone, my skin feels very soft to the touch, however, when looking in my makeup mirror, my skin doesn't look hydrated at all. It looks just like it did before using this moisturizer.

I think this might be more suited to someone younger and with oilier skin. The ingredients are nice, just not for my skin, unfortunately.

product_title: IPL Laser Hair Removal for Women and Men - At-Home Laser Hair Removal Permanent Upgrade to 999,999 Flashes - Handset Hair Removal Device Laser for or Facial Legs, Arms, Armpits, Body Treatment
review_title: coming from someone whose had pro 28 full body laser removal treatments and 50 hrs of electrolysis
review_text:
Needless to say i have xp with hair removal.  I was never really a super hairy but loved the feeling of being totally hairless from head to toe.

With all the sessions and hrs i barley have any hair but do have some spots on thighs, arms and other spots, that are fairly light even with all the professional laser treatments and electrolysis.  IPL aka this device is NOT the go-to treatment for hair reduction but it does work.

Firstly, you need to use an electric razor or standard razor on the areas your zapping.  Freshly showered, no oils or lotions on skin.  If you dont feel heat your not killing hair follicles.  The laser targets the pigment in the hair and absorbs the heat, so as they stated vampire skin, dark hair gets the best results.

If you have never gotten any sort of  pro hair removal your hair is going to be fuller and courser.  Like the subject heading states, ive had 28 full body laser hair removal treatments aka real hair removal that leaves you with red bumps, plus hrs of electrolysis and I still have hair grow back.

People it takes a long time to remove hair!  This is not designed to be a one zap and the hair is gone.  It will grow back finer and weaker, until it eventually is killed off.  It literally takes years.

I zap each spot 5 times on the highest setting.  The heat will build on each subsequent zap, meaning im actually hitting follicles.  I would not recommend this if you have course hair or never had pro hair removal - build up to that, but this device is a nice supplement to the pro hair removal.  It will never replace it and will take longer. For me its perfect and thats why i gave it 5 stars.

Once you zap the hair you should see a reaction, raised bumps, some redness, along the bikini line for example its very noticeable since the hair is courser - that means its working.  It takes about 10 -14 days for the zapped hair to push its way out.  Its not instant, the hair still remains in the follicle.  You can expedite this by lightly exfoliating in the bath or shower.  You may see little black spots in the follicle where the hair has been zapped and effectively targeted.

Hair grows in cycles, doing this every week is pointless, if the hair is not in the growth phase you cant kill it. Every 4 weeks, multiple zaps per spot and the hair WILL fall out and come back weaker.  Different areas have different growth cycles but 4 weeks is a good middle ground.

  This is used for hair reduction.  If you want permanent (still takes multiple treatments( you need electrolysis.

If you want faster hair reduction result you need to use laser only found at the dermatologist or reputable laser spa.  IPL is not laser treatment. This is not going to ever replace that.  A combination of all three over 3 or 4  years will leave you hairless, so keep your expectations realistic.

Love this fragrance!  It just smells so good!

business_name: Jessica Wolf's Art of Breathing: Collected Articles
product_title: Jessica Wolf's Art of Breathing: Collected Articles
review_title: Like Barbara Conable in her Body Mapping work
review_text:
I do not understand how a teacher of the Alexander Technique can miss the obvious, central issue in respiration – the support and opposition of the spine to the contraction of the muscles that move the ribs in breathing.
Was not Alexander’s first observation of his misuse of himself that he pulled his head back and down, compressing his larynx and shortening in stature, when he inhaled before speaking? Breathing Coordination (the method Carl Stough taught Jessica) makes this misuse the rule! Like Barbara Conable in her Body Mapping work, Jessica shows the spinal curves augmenting on inhalation, and, thus, stature decreasing – the opposite of what Alexander taught. What happens in healthy respiration is exactly the contrary -- the spinal curves diminish on inspiration, which gives the diaphragm and the muscles that support the ribcage the opposition they need to expand the thoracic cavity. Does it make any sense to attempt to increase lung volume by shortening?  What happened to allowing the back to lengthen and widen?
Further, in four-legged mammals, respiratory cycle is linked to gait, such that inspiration occurs only on extension  The mechanical needs of stride and respiration are co-ordinated. Every known running quadruped inhales on extension. Obviously, man has not evolved a respiratory system that functions best in a completely contradictory manner, independent of spinal support.
The central tendon of the diaphragm (aponeurosis) is joined to a neckwork of fascia, primarily through the pericardium, to which it is welded, that attaches to the upper ribs and cervical spine. It is completely fused to the pericardium, which surrounds the heart, and limits its movement. Thus, when the spine is allowed to lengthen on inspiration, the vertical travel of the diaphragm is limited, which maximizes its effect on the ribs. At the same time, the sternocleidomastoid muscles, which originate from the upper sternum, have their insertion in the mastoid process, on the skull behind the ears.  When the spine lengthens on inhalation, the sternocleidomastoids are prepared to provide support for the sternum against the contraction of the diaphragm and intercostal muscles.  Note that this is not the same as lifting the chest. The extension of the spine simply allows it to support the upper ribcage against the strong contraction of the diaphragm and para-sternal intercostal muscles that lift the ribs in inhalation.
Further, the scalenes, which descend from the transverse processes of the cervical vertebrae, attach to the 1st and 2nd  ribs. When the spine lengthens on inspiration, these muscles are supported so that their action may lift the top ribs, and so that contraction of the parasternal intercostals, which assist the diaphragm in lifting the ribs, does not compress the upper chest.
Physiologists have observed that abdominal muscles actually increase tone during inhalation, pressing the viscera inwards and creating upward pressure on the diaphragm, further restricting its descent, so that rib movement is maximized. When we’re breathing vigorously, especially, the diaphragm is pushed upward actively by contraction of the muscles of the abdominal wall. These raise the pressure in the abdomen, limiting the descent of the diaphragm by retaining the internal organs. Thus, we get the whole thoracic cage expanding in 3 dimensions, and the diaphragm works, not like a plunger, but more like an umbrella opening.
Look at it this way: if you go to lift a heavy weight, does the back shorten? Or does it lengthen to oppose the weight and support the action of muscles which, however, indirectly, depend on the spine for support?
Roger Fiammetti, in his Total Respiration, actually shows this fairly well, although he also over-emphases the vertical travel of the diaphragm. In this animation, one sees the spinal lengthen on inhalation, and relax back to a resting state on exhalation.
On Odile Rouquet’s DVD “Respiration et mouvement”, Philippe Campignion states:
(in translation from the original French): "When my diaphragm descends, my vertebral column rises, and during that time, my ribs are in torsion, this is quite complex; it is important to realize that if I'm focused on my diaphragm, I feel its descent, on the other hand, if I focus on my vertebral column, I feel something that rises, and when my diaphragm rises, at least when  the central tendon of the diaphragm rises, the thoracic cage descends.

In 1986, I took a workshop with Carl Stough (founder of Breathing Coordination). Even at that time, when I was training to teach the Alexander Technique, I saw him as someone with poor posture (or use of himself) who had developed a method for teaching people with poor posture how to get more air into their lungs by maximizing the vertical travel of the diaphragm, especially in exhalation. His method is, I believe, like many mechanical methods, a way to optimize breathing without improving overall use. I later took some private lessons in Stough’s method from the son of his partner. He actually had me slouch to let my belly soften (which Stough did not do), and certainly did not impress me as someone to emulate in respiration.
My 27 years of teaching the Alexander Technique to musicians, singers and dancers, and my years of experience studying dance, Tai-Chi and running, tell me that this is terribly wrong.

I will be using an older case for short trips.

business_name: Philips Norelco 1050CC arcitec Men's Shaving System
product_title: Philips Norelco 1050CC arcitec Men's Shaving System
review_title: BETTER than expected, very few issues!
review_text:
Before purchasing the Norelco Arcitec, I read reviews on Amazon and on various review websites I found with a simple Google search.  Some of the criticisms I've seen regarding the Arcitec are somewhat true, and many are not (at least in my case).  All people are different, and as such so is our facial hair, so please keep that in mind when reading any of these reviews including mine.

The Arcitec is my 2nd electric razor.  I tried a Braun foil-type razor about 6-7 years ago.  Basically the problem I had with the Braun razor is two fold:
1)  It didn't shave hair with any consistency, if at all.  Getting a close shave was impossible.
2)  Absolutely tore my face up.  Irritated my skin more than it shaved.

At that time I decided to go back to a standard razor and gel and let technology catch-up to my "dream razor".  I have zero problems with using a standard razor and gel - I'm able to get a close shave without any noticeable razor burn or irritation.  I just like not having to pick up a pack of razor heads and gel all the time, my schedule is simply too busy to even make it to the store, hence I buy things online and have them shipped to me.  I like having gadgets and hoped one day I could have a razor that worked well, looked great, and would provide a great shave for a long time to come without constantly needing to go get something for it or special maintenance.

Fast forward to today and I'm overly surprised at just how good the Norelco Arcitec is.  I'll go over the basics of the particular model I have (1050CC), the differences between the models, and what things I would consider pro's and con's.

The Arcitec Razor
First things first, this is an absolutely beautiful razor!  It looks and feels even better in your hand than on pictures on the Internet.  This is now the 4th day I've had and used this razor and feel I'm at a point where I can accurately describe my experience.  My first shave took about 10 minutes with 2 days of growth.  After my 4 day, I'm in and out in just a couple of minutes.  Each day the shave is truly better and faster.

+Pros+
1)  I'm able to get an extremely close shave. Easily rivals what I am able to do with a standard razor and gel.
2)  The hardest area to shave is the neck/jaw line.  With a few days practice I have been able to get these areas quite easily.
3)  Norelco recommends using this razor by itself for 21 days for your skin and beard to become accustomed to using the Arcitec.  I've had ZERO razor burn and/or irritation since the first day I've used it and yet somehow, everyday the shave is better, easier, and faster.  It's ADDICTING.
4)  The trimmer on the back is not near as useless as other reviewers are making it out to be.  Simply, the trimmer works well.  The only downside is that the shaving heads can get in the way of being able to see what it is that you're trimming at certain angles.  I have a separate cordless Norelco trimmer, but honestly as long as you're not doing ridiculously-extravagant facial hair, you should have no problem pulling out the trimmer on this product and cleaning up your sideburns, mustache, or other simple facial hair.  It IS NOT a toy like some reviewers are saying, it makes a nice clean line and cuts real close.
5)  The Jet Clean system is absolutely awesome.  I have no idea why other reviews have said to not get this.  Keeps the razor looking and feeling brand new, everyday, with no effort.  What is not to like?  I went on an Amazon subscription for the Jet Clean solution, so they send me a new bottle for like 3$-4$ shipped each month and I don't have to do anything.  This is reasonable.  Unit does ship with 1 bottle of solution which will last a month if you follow Norelco's suggestion.

-Cons-
1)  It's relatively expensive compared to most of the market.  Amazon's got a decent price on it, I personally picked mine up on Ebay for a fantastic price from a well-rated seller.
2)  The only criticism, other than price which is completely subjective, that I have read on reviews that holds any truth is the charging method.  Here's the deal if you haven't read this before:  The Arcitec comes with two methods of charging.  One is a travel case/charging pod.  I have yet to use this, however I can say that it is a well-made plastic case that the Arcitec fits inside.  On the outside of the case is a plug so it can be charged without having to take it out.  Other users were somewhat disappointed that the case is somewhat large and takes up a bit more space that older models.  Non-issue for me, honestly it's not that big at all and would easily fit in any bag I own except maybe my quite small Kenneth Cole laptop messenger bag that I use for work, in which case I'm working and not shaving.  The 2nd charging method is the Jet Clean/charging dock.  As mentioned previously the Jet Clean system works great, however the problem is that you CANNOT leave the unit plugged in.  What happens is you shave, either blow/wash out/brush out hairs in the Artitec (very easy by the way), then you place it on the Jet Clean system/charging dock and push power.  This initiates the cleaning cycle.  It takes only about an hour to clean, then a 2 hour dry-time. product_title: JULY 12 DISCOUNT: Lotus pure organics. Natural Mascara - Brown, Voluminous Lash-blast, Great For Sensitive Eyes, Super Long Lasting, Gluten Free, Cruelty Free, Lead Free, Non-Toxic Chemicals.
review_title: I was really disappointed in this mascara
review_text:
I was really disappointed in this mascara.  I wanted to love it, and maybe I just got a bad batch, but I'm pretty upset that I wasted $20 on this stuff!  If it IS just a bad batch, It's way too expensive to try it again.

Pros:
 - It smelled AMAZING, which I don't think I've ever said about mascara before...like blueberries!
 - It's organic.

Cons:
 - It was a much darker brown than I anticipated, but I could have worked with that, since it was organic and not stark black.
 - Dry AND Smudgy/runny!  I tried it three days in a row.  It flaked all over my face each time!  It clumped up on my lashes, and then smudged down underneath my eyes after a few hours.  At night I take off my makeup with makeup remover wipes, and I feel like it stained the skin under my eyes. Totally bizarre.

I wish it had worked.  It was way too expensive to be so flaky/ smudgy.  I've bought other organic mascaras that had none of those issues for half the price! Ecco Bella, for example: http://smile.amazon.com/gp/product/B000US0804?psc=1&redirect=true&ref_=oh_aui_search_detailpage
Great natural-looking mascara, just not the volume or lift I was looking for.  I guess I'll just keep looking.

I was very excited to try this product.  I wear a size 9.5 or 10 shoe.  The booties are to go up to shoe size 12 - so I was very surprised to find the booties were Short  on my feet.  I Googled to see how long in inches a size 10 shoe is - it is 10 1/4 inches.  A size 9.5 is 10 1/8 inches long.  A size 12 shoe is 10 7/8 inches.  The Bootie was so short on my feet I felt like toes were going to double under my foot.  After wearing the booties for the 90 minutes I took them off and measured them.  They measured 11 inches.  I do not wear a wide shoe but lets face it - the length will be taken up some by the width of the foot.
I sent a note to the company and received a response back that my booties had shipped and they would ask the factory to make the templates for larger sized feet.
I don't want another pair of booties - I want my money refunded as these do not fit as advertised.

Overall this is a comfortable affordable pillow.

I hope these are better at applying makeup than they are at blotting it.  Because that's what they're getting relegated to.

review_text:
Update: 10/26/2018
First, I must say that the authentic Japanese Shiseido Perfect Whip is wonderful!  Now here is why I reduced my review from 5 stars to 1:

When I first ordered this, I got the authentic Japanese one and gave the review below.  I was about to use up my second tube, so I ordered two more.  Then my skin started to break out horribly, was so dry and looked awful, even with makeup on.  I couldn't figure out why, because nothing had changed!  Then I realized that I had just started using the new tube of Perfect Whip I ordered.

I took a look at the tube and it was Chinese!  I trusted this was authentic and didn't even inspect the tube before using it, so I was infuriated!  There's a little Japanese on the front, but the back is all Chinese under the English label.
I guess it's the luck of the draw, which company will fulfill the order, but if you receive the Chinese one, do not use it and get a refund!  Not only is it a waste of money, it's so harsh on your skin!
As you will see in my original review, I hate harsh products, but I used bodywash on my face until I could get to the store and that was way better than this garbage! I immediately saw a difference and my face cleared up.  I just grabbed a random face wash, so now my search for a good one begins again.
I will not risk ordering this again.

Original review of authentic Perfect Whip 6/22/2018:
I grew up in Japan and spent most of my life there, so Japanese skincare was all I knew.
They say the best way to wash your face is to use a foaming net to create a thick foam and gently wash your face with the foam. Never vigorously wash with your hands, because that creates friction and scratches your skin. Of course cleansing brushes are too rough too! Their products also have so many different benefits; moisturizing, plumping, brightening your complexion and so many more!

Then I came back to the US.
I had no idea I would have trouble finding face wash! I tried so many, but it seems that they're too harsh, such as scrubs or bar soaps, just a cleanser or they don't foam at all!
I decided to check Amazon and found this.
I knew about this while in Japan, but just never tried it and boy do I wish I had!

It has a light pleasant scent and I put a tiny bit (pea-sized amount) on my foaming net and the foam was so rich and thick! Just like whipped cream! I can gently wash my face and my face was so smooth and plump afterwards! Just one wash made a huge difference! My foundation goes on better and I feel better about myself when I have no makeup on!

I also use Japanese lotion (Japanese version of toner, but way better!) afterwards. I have normal skin, but moisturizing creams are too greasy for me.

I'm so glad that Amazon carries these products!
This is very affordable and I will continue to use this!

review_title: Cheap, flimsy, cosmetic bag that has limited hanging options and is not worth consideration in my opinion
review_text:
I am sorry I ordered this bag and am very disappointed. It's cheap, flimsy, and holds light items. Items have a tendency of tilting outward in the pockets depending on the size of the item and are at risk of falling out. The detachable clear plastic tote at the bottom is a nice touch, but that is about it. The zippers are sticky.

In my opinion this cosmetic / travel organizer will not last at all. My biggest complaint is the hook for hanging. It is not a full-size hanger hook so there are a limited number of places to hang this. It can be hung on a wire shelf with holes (like a shower caddy or closet with wire inserts) but it does not hang on a shower rod or on a closet rod or any rod much thicker than a finger.

This cosmetic bag is not even worth consideration in my opinion.

review_text:
I got this to help with my ear and nostril piercings. My ear piercings  had tightened up after many years of not wearing jewelry. I could barely fit standard earrings in but the left side would hurt after a short time and I would have to remove it. My piercer stretched them just to a 16g. My nostril gets a little sore and irritated when removing and inserting jewelry for cleaning.
Even though I shower and scrub my ears and jewelry daily I sometimes get that funky yeasty cheesy smell. I found out that can happen when they have been stretched, even if just a small amount.
I also wanted something to make inserting earrings and nostril rings easier.
So enter Smelly Gelly. Something I tried to put on my skin and jewelry.
Pros
Cute little tin.
I would imagine even with this small amount that it would last a lot time.
After cleaning and applying in the morning I didn’t notice a cheesy smell at bedtime like I sometimes do. Although by morning it was back and yes I used fresh pillowcases.
Low product price

Cons
Shipping is an extra cost. Not prime and not free.
It’s a hard wax. Even warming it with my hands it stays just a hard, tacky wax.
It didn’t lubricate my jewelry to make it any easier to insert.
It smells like oil that has gone rancid.
I had to stir it up to get any scent besides old oil to appear.
The only faint scent that came out when stirred was maybe of eucalyptus.
When used in my nostril jewelry I was stuck with the rancid oil smell all day.
It did not help with nostril irritation from changing out jewelry.

I’m really bummed as I went back and forth deciding between this and similar products. I went with this because I wanted the essential oils that the other products were lacking.

review_title: Best Battery Powered Brush We Have Ever Used Cleans As Good As Clarisonic Which We Also Have
review_text:
We have been through several Clarisonic brushes in our house (Mine kept dying) and my daughter swears by her Clarisonic Mia.  She has to go to a camp which has a lot of other teens at it for a week to work for a city reach out program.  She wanted to bring her Clarisonic, but I talked her into trying this one out.  It is easy to transport and use and if it is lost or taken, it is not as expensive to replace.

WHAT IS THIS BRUSH LIKE?
First of all, this comes in a nice hard case which is great for travel.  It comes with one soft brush for daily use and a harder brush for once a week or so use.  There is a silicone brush head which is for dry sensitive skin types.  The brush runs on batteries which did not come with our unit.  They are AA batteries.  There are two speeds- slower for daily use and higher for the harder brush to exfoliate.

HOW DOES IT WORK?
There are two speeds.  The first speed is very slow and my daughter is not fond of it.  She prefers to use it on the second speed which is faster.  Since it runs on batteries, it is not going to have the consistency as a plug in version.  My daughter prefers the exfoliating brush and uses it 2 times a week.  She feels that it cleans her skin as good or better than her Clarisonic Mia as it gets rid of the dead skin cells leaving her skin softer and more clear too.

It seems to be very waterproof.  My daughter uses this in the shower and has had no problems with it.  After almost a month of use, twice a week, she is not having problems with the batteries running down yet.  She does  a lot of house sitting so having this handy has been great.

AFTER EXFOLIATING BRUSH
After using the exfoliating brush, my daughter wanted me to mention that it is important to put on good moisturizer as the skin has been exfoliated well and you will need to make sure to use moisturizer on the face to protect the skin as it repairs.

THE BOTTOM LINE
If you want the cleaning of a Clarisonic Mia but want something more travel friendly that cleans well, this might be a brush for you to try out.  Working best on the second speed with the exfoliating brush, twice a week does the trick for our daughter.  She really likes it and thinks it works as good or at times better than her Clarisonic Mia which she still has.

MY RATING
FIVE STARS for this one although it is not fair to grade it against the Clarisonic which is electrically powered, it works as well but does have the battery power.  I debated giving it four stars, but it does work better than any battery powered brush we have tested so far, so I am leaving it at five.  The soft brush is not too great, though, so perhaps see this as FOUR AND A HALF.

product_title: New Straight Edge Stainless Steel Barber Razor Folding Fold Shaving Shave Knife Cut Tool for Male Acrylic Handle (Deep Blue)
review_text:
Initial impressions. This is a higher quality gold dollar factory made razor. It has good balance and appears symmetric. The scales are good quality acrylic but a little too thick. The blade comes to rest but due to the thickness of the scales they must push apart a little to fit it. It is not shave ready. After I hone it I will update this review.
Over all initial impressions are good. Some of the other gold dollars assembly quality and grinding I’ve had were a joke. But they all eventually took a beautiful edge and held it. I buy these for when I travel instead of taking my expensive or vintage ones. And I like to tinker a bit and practice my honing techniques.

Update
This razor unfortunately would not take an edge. Therefore it went to the trash. It’s too bad these are a hit and miss. Some are hardened and tempered properly and others are not.

review_text:
I feel that the DND gel nail polish does better using their base and top coat :) i will update my review in a few weeks to see how long my manicure lasts.

05-10-2021 UPDATE -
So.... I haven’t used this base and top coat almost a year now. Now that I’m more knowledgeable when it comes down to nail service, this top coat and gel base isn’t the best. Consistency is quite thick. This product puddles a lot specially the top coat. Even with preparing the nail properly this product puddles on your nails. It’s so extremely annoying and even after curing it and wiping the sticky residue, it doesn’t feel so smooth. I bought several top coats after this just to see what other products work best and have now found one top coat that is amazing. I have been using Young Nails Stain Resistant  gel top coat and iGel Beauty base. It works so much better. Doesn’t puddle, leaves a smooth surface, even if your nail isn’t smooth before applying it, this does the trick. It hides all imperfections. So in conclusion please don’t waste your money buying DND top and base coat.

review_title: Attractive hair accessories in 3 styles and 9 colors
review_text:
Suptikes 9 Hair Scrunchies and 7 Decorative clips make a nice set of hair accessories.  The scrunchies come in three different styles, plain circle, short bow and long streaming bow.

The material is described as Korean satin and they do have a silky feel to them.  The colors are muted and quite attractive with a nice selection that makes them easy to coordinate with a variety of outfits.

The seven hair clips are gold tone with decorative accents.  Two of the clips are 2.5 inches long, three are 2.25 inches long and the two shortest are 2 inches long.

This Suptikes scrunchie and clip set is a very attractive and well priced.  They hold the hair in place and I do recommend them to anyone who wear scrunchies and likes soft, sophisticated colors.

review_text:
This is a really nice tinted moisturizer. I run my own eco farm full time & need a lot of sun protection. I always wear a wide brimmed Sloggers brand hat along with a natural tinted moisturizer with SPF.

Lesentia with a SPF of 31, provides natural looking coverage & helps to keep my skin tone more even looking. It adds a nice warm touch of color that is perfect for summer wear. It performs exactly as described. It does leave a shine, so I touch it up with Organic Wear pressed powder. There are no weird ingredients or fragrances.

Another natural tinted moisturizer I like is by Organic Wear. Organic Wear provides a very thin, light coverage that requires a little bit of pressed powder to tone down the shine.

Overall, I'm glad I decided to try this. I hope they decide to offer other coverage options besides medium. I'd like to get it in a lighter version for winter use.

review_title: Excellent quality. Very attractive assortment of confetti and glitter polishes. Small bottles.
review_text:
This is an excellent assortment of attractive, quality gel polish, with base coat and top coat (no wipe and matte versions). The presentation elevates the worth as a gifting option.  One of the best features of this set is the bottles of gel polish provide actual representations of the contents. On the top of the cap is a sticker with proper identification of the color (including glitter, confetti varieties). Also on the front label is a small circle, under the brand name, that has an accurate portrayal of the contents. Finally, a company gets it. So, this boosts the rating a bit.
There are 16 varieties of gel polish, with confetti and glitter. The consistency is perfect, allowing application of a thin coat. An ability to apply a thin coat is essential, mainly due to the size of these bottles. They are 5ml (0.17fl oz), which is one of the smallest bottles of gel polish that i've encountered. This is actually a disappointing size/quantity of gel polish. Based on the size of the bottles of gel polish, I consider this to actually be a sampler set, as opposed to a set of 'normal' sized bottles of attractive confetti, glitter gel polishes. So, i guess one can try out the various polishes and then purchase larger bottles of desired varieties.
Overall, I feel all of the polishes in the assortment are visually attractive. The polishes are excellent quality, and produce excellent results. The significant other tested the gel on some fake nails, and i commented that it looks beautiful as is...no need to add any embellishments/decorations. She agreed., but said she'd combinde solid color gel polish with these, and add some rhinestones or other decorations, maybe create a marbled effect. I could see her creative juices flowing.
The product does match the descriptions and pictures in the product details. The presentation is effective and top notch. We like the quality and consistency of the gel polishes and base/top coats.  If the bottles were at least the size of the base/top coat bottles, this set would be perfect and worth 5 stars. As currently configured, based on observations and impressions, this quality 'sampler' set earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a high level recommendation.

business_name: JIADEL Gel Nail Polish Colors Set,Confetti Glitter Gel Nail Polish With No Wipe Base and Top Coat,Soak Off UV LED Nail Art Salon Starter Manicure Kit
product_title: JIADEL Gel Nail Polish Colors Set,Confetti Glitter Gel Nail Polish With No Wipe Base and Top Coat,Soak Off UV LED Nail Art Salon Starter Manicure Kit
review_text:
All of the colors look amazing! I tested a few of them on a piece of white cardboard and can't wait to try them all! Unlike other gel polish brands this one gives you two ways of easily identifying the colors. Each bottle has a clear opening in the front of the bottle as well as a color sticker on top. Those are very useful but some colors are still hard to make out so I had to open them to get a better look.
I applied the base coat and found that it was a bit thicker than expected. I have used some other brands of gel base coats and the consistency is generally thinner. Most of the polishes are light but not to the point of being watery. It's the same consistency as non gel polishes which I prefer. However, some of the glittered polishes that have confetti included are pretty thick and almost chunky. I'm not sure that it will last long based off the consistency at first use. I hope they do last because those are some of the prettiest colors. I love that unlike other brands of gel polishes that I've used, this brand's glitter polishes are not opaque. It's both shiny and the color is dense. I put on the color A708 first cured it then topped it with A707 while leaving some of the color A708 visible. I then layered it with the color A712 on a diagonal so that some of the color A708 would still be visible. I know the colors are hard to make out from the photo. I realized after the fact that I probably should've started with the color A707 or A712 first. I used number A707 and A708 alternating on the remaining toes. I finished it by putting a gloss top coat and cured it with the UV light. I set it to 60 seconds for three rounds just to make sure the polish dried fully. It has been two days and so far so good. The photo of my toenails were taken on day two.
Overall, I love the color selections. They're very pretty hence why I chose to use 3 colors at once. I can't wait to use the rest of the colors. I really love this set. I like to paint my toes colors that are compatible with the current season so these color selections are perfect for my seasonal needs. I wish the bottle sizes were a bit larger but I guess they make up for that by offering a lot of color selections. Also, you don't need to cake on the polish. A little goes a long way. The only drawback is that the base coat seemed a bit too thick so it may not last, but it could be an isolated case with this set. It's not a deal breaker though, which is why I'm still giving it 5 stars. Plus you can always buy another base coat.

review_text: I was going to save this as a Christmas gift for my nieces but just could not resist and had to give it to them early. They aren't allowed to go to a real nail salon/spa yet so I planned an at home "spa day" for them, with their mom's approval of course. They had to "wait in line" for their turn while I painted their toes and gave them a stack of magazines to flip through. It was such a fun experience for them without having to spend a fortune, and in the safety of our home. The foot spa machine itself is pretty cool, and is almost like the one I have for myself. I did use warm water - the machine doesn't heat up or anything, so make sure you use lukewarm water for the little feets! I went a step further and even gave them an exfoliating foot scrub which is something I already have at home for myself. This is honestly the best $40 spent - an experience like this in a "real" salon and spa would have easily cost more than $40 for two girls. The great thing about this is that it is a suitable item for a wide range of ages, even after they've entered their teen years. I highly recommend this set.

review_title: Very nice green coloration. Decent design/construction. Great value/bargain.
review_text:
This is a decently designed and manufactured massage roller and gua sha set.  The aventurine/jade stones are nicely color matched, exhibiting attractive green gradations. Of course, each set will differ due to natural variations of the stone. But, the set received is visually similar to the images in the product details.
The massage roller has the plastic grommets where the metal arms/axles enter the stone rollers. These plastic aspects protect the metal and stone from abrasive interaction, which would affect the longevity. These plastic grommets also act as a bearing, allowing for smooth motion/interaction while using/rolling the tool.  Having these in place is indicative of competent design and construction.
The gua sha follows the traditional heart shape. It also is of the flatter version. This version is not as thick, and has a flattened characteristic. The edges are rounded, so harsh sharp edges are not present.
The aventurine/jade stones are not highly polished. The surfaces are reasonably smooth, but not with the glass like sheen of high quality rollers and gua sha. Depending on your personal preferences, this more natural stone feel might be considered a desired tactile quality.
Attached are photos to show real world images, with a ruler for size reference. Inspection of the tools found no defects or flaws. The stones were free of scratches, nicks.
I am very amazed at the current cost of $8. A comparable gua sha, alone, would cost about $8 or $9. A comparable aventurine massage roller could be had for $9 - $12. These comparison prices are the low end of the range for those respective items. So, the price for this set of a massage roller and gua sha is beyond competitive. It's an excellent value/bargain.
Accordingly, this very competent, cost effective set earns a 4.5 - 4.75 star rating, with a very high level recommendation.

review_text:
I ordered these because I have only half brows and meet to finish them by penciling them in, and this can be difficult to make both sides match up.

With this set you can pick the stencil that best matches your natural brows and then use the pencil to create brows. I didn’t use the whole stencil because most of them would create a pretty large brown but I use them to create the shape and make them both uniform. You pick a stencil then do one side then flip the stencil to do the other stencil.

Works pretty well but you will probably need to do some of your creativity to make them look more natural.

Over all these are pretty helpful especially when you have the need to draw on brows daily, it speeds of the process and makes sure your aren’t leaving the house with 2 totally different brows.🤨

review_text:
I love the concept of an individual towelette, not only for convenience, but because I can go from fragrance free to smelling delicious in a heartbeat. Lunch with someone sensitive to perfume and dinner with someone who isn't.
That being said, I believe that this delivery system lends itself better to lighter fragrances.
On unwrapping the packet, you smell a dark, bitter chocolatey, red wine kind of note. Definitely unique. Usually gourmand fragrances are geared for youth, but this is all grown up and adult.
Too intense for warm weather, ok for fall and winter.

review_text:

It is sad that Amazon is showing original Salux cloth picture for this item.  They have separate sticker made and pasted on this item wrapping with Salux cloth UPC code.  Looks like total fraud.  This cheap item is also Made In China.

I bought this to replace my 6 months old original Salux cloth.  With just one wash, my 6 months old Salux cloth and this 1 day old cheap knock off looks same.  So, buy at your own risk.  If you used original Salux cloth before, you will know this is not the same and it is cheap.  But this may spoil the value of Salux cloth for new users.

product_title: Splat Original Complete Hair Dye Kit in Pink Fetish
review_title: Splat is AWFUL! DO NOT USE IT EVER!
review_text:
Splat is AWFUL! I tried to die my hair Lusty Lavender in January of this year. Instead, the insanely strong bleach over-processed my hair. Essentially, my hair will not hold any kind of color – permanent or temporary. As a result, I've had to dye my hair 10 times in the last 6 months every time with permanent hair color. After 5-6 washes, I have to re-dye my hair again because the color fades. This product is horrible and damaging to your hair. DO NOT USE IT EVER!

The only good thing about this product is when I called Splat (Christine – (951) 738-8595), they sent over two free bottles of the same hair color. The tops of the clear processing liquid exploded in shipping, and the boxes were damaged. It took me 2 months from original contact to call them in regards to the issue. The lady above didn’t even ask to see photos of the damaged boxes as proof she simply sent two more boxes. Essentially, I received four free packs of hair color because of the one that originally did damage to my hair. I was able to use small bottles of 20 Cream Developer from Sally’s (much healthier than the clear stuff originally in the packs) and sell all four boxes of color. At least that’s some vindication for what occurred.

If enough people that were wronged by this company took this approach, we could bring down this horrible, faulty company for good. Think about it ladies and gentlemen, and take some action. Maybe if they lose enough profits they will do something about their low quality products.

review_text:
I have dry skin and hair, so I'm always looking for new moisturizers. I love Argan oil and have had great results with it. This is a lovely oil. It's very light and absorbs quickly. I love using it on my legs. It has no color or real scent. On your body it's very nice and hydrates your skin without leaving you greasy.

I also had great results using it on my hair and a little goes a long way. I especially like it on my ends. It's wonderful to soften and repair damaged hair.

Very nice oil, would recommend. Great for anyone with dry skin who likes oils.

What Is Skin Bleaching?

Skin bleaching is a cosmetic treatment to reduce the prominence of skin discolorations and even out the color of the skin. You can buy bleaching creams over the counter and by prescription.

Some people apply skin lightener to their entire body to change their complexion, but this can be very risky. The active ingredient in some skin lighteners is mercury, so bleaching can lead to mercury poisoning.

Mercury is a toxic agent that can cause serious psychiatric, neurological, and kidney problems. Pregnant women who use a skin lightener with mercury can pass the mercury to their unborn child.

The use of mercury as an ingredient in skin lighteners is banned in the U.S. However, some skin lighteners produced outside the U.S. may still contain mercury.
How Do Skin Lighteners Work?

Skin lighteners contain an active ingredient or a combination of ingredients that reduces the amount of melanin in the skin where it is applied.

How Do Skin Lighteners Work? continued...

The most widely used ingredient in skin lighteners sold in the U.S. is hydroquinone.

The FDA regulates the use of hydroquinone in the U.S. Over-the-counter skin lighteners can contain up to 2% hydroquinone. Dermatologists can write prescriptions for lighteners that contain 4%-6% hydroquinone.

It's important to check with your doctor before using a product with hydroquinone and to follow the doctor's directions exactly.

Other skin lighteners use drugs such as steroids and retinoic acid, which comes from vitamin A, as active ingredients. And some skin lighteners use natural ingredients such as kojic acid -- a compound that comes from a fungus -- and arbutin, a compound found in various plants.
Risks of Skin Lighteners

One of the most significant risks of using some skin lighteners is the potential exposure to mercury. One study found that nearly 1 out of every 4 skin lighteners made in Asia and sold outside the U.S. contained mercury.

There are other potential risks of skin lighteners. Those risks can include the following:

Prolonged use can contribute to premature aging of skin.
Long-term use may increase the risk of skin cancer from sun exposure. Always use sunscreen when using a skin lightener and going out in the sun.
Steroids in some skin lighteners may increase risk for skin infections, skin thinning, acne, and poor wound healing.
Applying steroids to large areas of skin may put you at risk for health problems related to steroid being absorbed by the body.
Hydroquinone may cause unwanted and untreatable skin discoloration (ochronosis).
Various bleaching agents, including natural ingredients, can cause skin irritation or allergic reaction.

product_title: Ovonni Electric Makeup Brush Cleaner with USB Charging Station, Automatic Instantly Wash and Dry Cosmetic Brushes, Quick and Easy Cleaning Solution
review_text:
I really wanted to like this but it is flat out useless. I charged it fully, then tried to use it on a few different brushes of mine. My brushes are fairly thick so I used the second from the biggest holder. I pushed it all the way in and made sure it fit snugly, but when I turned it on it was very wobbly. When I put the brush in the water, it would barely spin. I tried raising it up and down to see if there was a sweet spot but no matter what I did, it wouldn't spin enough to do anything. I had to clean my brushes the old fashion way.
The black part that goes on top of the bowl wouldn't fit on the rim and kept falling into the bowl, so I ended up taking it off all together.
Also, don't keep this charging in your bathroom overnight if you have an open bathroom. The bright blinking light will keep you up.

review_text:
I initially tried this as a body scrub. I find it is too dry & too much got wasted to be effective.

I make my own cold process milk soaps & thought I'd give this a try that way. I make up my batch & mix some of this into part of the batter to do a layered swirl mix as to not over power the soap & make it too gritty. The bars look great & smell great, plus there is the natural exfoliation which is wonderful for the hands as well as the body.

I personally love this as a kitchen hand soap because it really helps to remove cooking smells from the skin. Plus, the granules make for a wonderful, although brief hand massage.

No toxic fragrances or perfumes, just natural safe ingredients.

Overall, I am more than pleased.

This is my kind of sugar scrub. It cleans and exfoliates while it also hydrates my skin. When I get out of the tub or shower I don’t have to apply lotion to my body because the scrub left my skin completely moisturized.

The sugar in this product does the job of exfoliating and making the skin fresh and new. The oil in the product does the moisturizing, much better than just a lotion after because it really coats the skin.

There will be some residue left in the tub or shower that has to be rinsed with really hot water when done or it will be slippery for the next shower or bath.

Definitely a recommend for anyone that understands what this product is.

review_title: Formerly great razor replaced with garbage
review_text:
The Barbasol Ultra 3 was the best disposable razor I had ever found. I was planning to keep buying these for the rest of my life.

Then Barbasol drastically decreased the quality of the razor, leaving the price the same. The close, comfortable shave I was accustomed to is gone, replaced by a scratchy, patchy experience.

The most obvious change is the razor's handle, which is now a kind of half-shell that probably uses 50% less plastic. The plastic strip directly beneath the blades has been completely changed, too.

I don't have any of the old razors left to compare to the new version, but another reviewer on Amazon (Unseen World, 7/18/2020) was able to compare them side by side, and he pointed out that the new version has a narrower range of swivel, so it's not able to follow the contours of your face as well. Given how much worse this razor shaves, I wouldn't be surprised if Barbasol also decreased the quality of steel in the blades.

I used to be able to get at least two close, comfortable shaves out of one of these razors before throwing it away. Now I can't get even ONE decent shave.

What happened? Did Barbasol run into supply-chain issues during the pandemic and decide not to warn their customers? Or are they in financial trouble and trying to cut costs any way they can? Or, did they just get greedy and decide to increase their profit margin, thinking no one would notice?

I would love to hear from a Barbasol representative on this.

For what it's worth, I'm aware that Barbasol also makes a six-bladed disposable razor, which I've tried. It's heavy and clumsy and doesn't shave nearly as well as the old version of the Ultra 3. More blades do not automatically make for a better shave. (Where will it all end? A 20-bladed disposable razor the size of my whole face, which somehow magically shaves me in one stroke? Ridiculous.)

review_title: Great for home or the salon
review_text:
There is plenty to like about this kit.

First, I like that it's USB powered.  That is a major convenience, especially if using in a professional setting.  Secondly, it's got good balance and is ergonomically pleasing.  A great feature when you're using is regularly.

My sister, who has been a professional for 20 years, said it was among the sharpest (in a good way!) she's ever used.  Obviously this is huge when working on customers and you don't want to pulling hair out when you're trying to cut it.

With the myriad attachments, there's really very little you can't do with it.  And best of all, the price is great for what you get.  I would recommend this for both home and professional settings.

The battery length isn't great, but it also charges really quickly, so it's simply a matter of being mindful of it.

review_title: NOT a nail buffer - this is a file - worth maybe $8 so way over-priced
review_text: A nail buffer requires a very, very, very fine grit so it will polish and shine the nail. This supposed buffer is medium grit, which means it is good for filing nail edges and maybe ok for removing ridges from the nail surface if you use very light pressure, but it will not polish the nail top surface - i.e. despite the name, this is a file.  When used on the nail top surface, it mostly produces scratches. Even if the grit on this file was fine enough, it is too wide to properly polish the small curved surface of a nail (I am not talking thickness/height here, I mean width).  Plus decorative top is just glued on.  I have tried so many glass nail buffers that I have lost count - all were too wide and too coarse to actually buff the nail except one - the one that actually had a fine enough grit was so wide that it could only polish my nails in spots.  I would love a long-lasting glass nail buffer, but at this point my conclusion is that glass is not suitable for buffing because it is too rigid and all supposed glass buffers available are very badly designed.  I give up.  I guess I will continue with disposable 4-sided soft block buffers - at least those work properly.  Gave the file to my niece as she loves the appearance of it and it is good for filing (properly etched, medium grit), just way over-priced at $13 and NOT as described.

Sprayed this & let it dry.
Applied a cream foundation that I've used before but, this time, it seemed to spread more evenly & easily and it looked really smooth & nice!
Received husband compliments & girlfriends at event compliments!
Whatever the magic is in this spray bottle, I'll be sure to keep it on hand.

review_text:
I enjoyed using and reviewing this salt/rock mixture. I could never imagine paying $34 for a single bath, so this was likely a once in a lifetime experience for me.

Pros: It smelled great and had a great salt texture. The oils felt silky smooth and I enjoyed the 30 minute bath. However, I did not feel any different after the bath as per usual.

Cons: The  bath costs more than a trigger point massage. My back, leg, shoulder muscles felt about the same following a typical epsom salt bath. So the oils and texture appear to be more for the bath experience than the healing.

I regretfully have to deduct 2 full stars for the price and 1 star for the 1 ounce rock that could clog your plumbing if it slides down the drain.
