review_title: Great alternative to soaking your gel nail polish off.
review_text:
This stuff is pretty amazing when it comes to removing stubborn gel polish.
Steps:
1. Use a rough grit nail file to gently rough up the surface of the polish.
2. Apply a pretty thick coat of the remover all over the surface of the gel polish.
3. Wait 1-2 mins
4. Use orange wood pusher stick to gently scrape off polish
5. If polish still has remnants, file surface again gently, and add another fairly thick layer of remover
6. Wait 1-2 more minutes
7. Use stick to scrape nail again
8. Finally, smooth nail surface with file and clean up dust with rubbing alcohol.
Done!
I definitely recommend this stuff, bc it's easier and quicker than slowly soaking in acetone.

review_text:

It felt deeply hydrating and the Vitamin C helps brighten and even out skin tone.

I have sensitive skin but did not experience any irritation, sensitivity or redness using this product.

review_text:
If you're looking to build your gel polish collection on a budget, this set of 20 colors from Rosegin has you covered. There's a little bit of everything in this kit - crèmes, full coverage microglitters, jellies, and crelly finishes. They also include a base, as well as glossy and matte no-wipe topcoats (both of which are phenomenal!) The glossy top is super shiny and the matte top looks like velvet.

Rosegin curated a lovely rainbow assortment of mini gel colors in this set. You get pastels and primary colors, but no black or white polish is included. The bottles are 5ml; though they look tiny, they're filled to the top and contain enough product for several mani's. I swatched 12 out of the 20 shades in this kit and the formulas are amazing! Smooth and buttery. Beautifully pigmented - 2 coats to full coverage. The glitters aren't thick or clumpy, and don't leave bald spots during application. The brushes fan out nicely on the nail and make the polishes easy to control. There is no offensive odor to any of these and they cured within 60 secs in my LED lamp. I cannot speak to the wear time with these as I always wear a peel-off base or full cover tips with gel polish products.

I've shown both the glossy and matte top coats with my swatches. All colors are shown at 2 easy coats. These are fabulous for the price and I wholeheartedly recommend them. I will definitely be checking out other Rosegin products! The colors are gorgeous and the quality is outstanding! Everything in this set comes beautifully boxed - perfect for gifting!

product_title: Organic Self Tanner for Face and Body - Streak Free Sunless Tanner - Self Tanning Lotion with Manuka Honey and Aloe Vera - Fake Tan for Fair to Medium Skin - Indoor Tanning Lotion with Bronzer (8oz)
review_text:
As a 42 year old woman with shockingly pale skin I thought it would be interesting to try a sunless tanner. When I was younger I used Jergens sunless tanner and unless I was extremely careful and diligent I ended up orange, streaked or some combination of the two. I did not have high hopes for this sunless tanner, so I started with a small area on one leg.

First, this lotion does not have any real scent straight out of the bottle, but it does have a smell that develops once it is on the skin. It is not unpleasant and maybe the scent is dependent on the person, but it is there. Second, it is easy to apply. The first application I only put a tiny amount on my right leg and then immediately washed my hands. I let it dry for about one minute and then got dressed. Simple. Third, it takes a bit for color to appear. I started to tan in about 12 hours and by the next morning I was noticeably browner.

The second application I put on both my legs just like normal lotion. I tried paying attention to my knees and ankles, but honestly, I did not really. I washed my hands immediately, but must have brushed my forearm. I let everything dry for about one minute and then got dressed. The next morning I was tan and had a streak of brown on my arm.

I like this stuff. It is easy to use and the color lasts. My super pale skin accepts the color and I don't look nearly as translucent.

review_title: Much too needle sharp to use anywhere near a pet’s face
review_text:
LBSXQGS 8 Pcs Pet Tear Stain Remover Comb, Double-Sided Dog Eye Comb Brush is designed to remove mucus and crust around a dog’s eyes that can lead to tear stains.

The problem is that the comb side is needle sharp.  I punctured my thumb just picking it up.  I would not recommend putting this comb anywhere near a pet, much less around the eyes.

Since I have three little white dogs who needs their eyes cleaned daily, I thought the brush side might work and did try that.  It is useless and couldn’t clean anything around their face.  Instead I will continue to use saline saturated cotton balls and a fine plastic baby comb which does not pose any danger to my dogs.

LBSXQGS 8 Pcs Pet Tear Stain Remover Comb, Double-Sided Dog Eye Comb Brush has needle like teeth that can easily puncture skin.  I would not recommend this for use on any pet.

review_text:

Results:
-it’s a mediocre clay mask
- dries within the 5-10 minutes as described depending on how thick you layer it on
- easily washes off with water
- my face looked exactly the same before and after with no significant changes

Overall, I think this is just another hyped up product which doesn’t deliver anything extraordinary. Clay masks typically reduce oil and tighten enlarged pores but this one does neither significantly. I’ve used better clay masks than this one. Done waste your money, or if you’re like me and just “want to try it” go for it...maybe you’ll have a different opinion.

review_title: Makeup klutz me can actually use this! Very easy to apply & draw…
review_text:
Full disclosure: I’m a makeup klutz who has no business posting a pic of eyebrows BUT — for the 1st time, I found a product that let me actually draw some in!
My brows never fully grew back after chemo in 2005, so I’ve just learned to love my sparse & whispy nothings.
This pen, though, is pretty goof proof! I think it’s the way the end is shaped with 4 little tips similar to a fork… the lines that come out aren’t thick & bold, but they can be if you just keep drawing over & over.

My daughter is a brow fill-in champ, so I will definitely have her help me next time she’s home but, in the meantime, I will recommend this product since if I can use it, anyone can!
I’m timid about big dark brows, but will try a little more each day. At just under $10, it’s a great value for an excellent product.

**Thank you for reading this review & I hope that it’s Helpful!**

review_text:

All of our stair lifts can be installed by a competent handy man in 3 hours or less.

Some of our competitors, and organizations they belong to, would lead consumers to believe that self-installation of a stair lift could possibly create safety issues. AmeriGlide would suggest that the facts speak for themselves. AmeriGlide has sold over 30,000 straight stair lifts throughout the United States most of which have been installed by the homeowner or a handy man they know. We are pleased to advise all consumers that AmeriGlide has never had a reported case of anyone injured on a stair lift we sold. Zero cases!

We at AmeriGlide would prefer to let the facts speak for themselves. We suspect those that disagree with our position do so for multiple reasons none of which can be supported by facts but rather their desire to protect the "status quo" of the industry. AmeriGlide's mission is to provide quality stair lifts at the most affordable prices with the specific objective of increasing utilization by lower the entry cost for the consumer. That is exactly what we have done over the last ten years.

AmeriGlide management are the initiators of Do It Yourself Stair lift Installation. In 2000, management identified stair lifts as a product that was underutilized in the United States and determined that underutilization was a result of high cost to the consumer. Our objective was to produce and market a stair lift solution that would cost the consumer less than $2,000 thus making resolution of stair accessibility issues affordable. We at AmeriGlide pride ourselves on offering stair lift products that are affordable, safe, easy to install, and undoubtedly the best value in the market. Our customers obviously agree as they have made us the #1 stair lift provider in the United States.

For those of you that prefer we offer nationwide installation of our stair lifts. We believe the consumer is intelligent enough to make the choice that is best suited to their individual needs, skills, and budget.

Please note, AmeriGlide does not recommend or support Do It Yourself Installation of most other manufacturer's stair lifts. We do offer and support DIY installation of some select used stair lifts made by other manufactures.

Thank you,
Jeff Sheffer
President
Ameriglide, Inc.

product_title: Philips Norelco 8140XL SpeedXL Men's Shaver
review_text:
I bought this to replace a Norelco Cool Skin shaver. I had the Cool Skin for 2 years and loved it, but the battery wore out.

The Speed XL 7800XLCC is a waste of money. There is no "Speed" in this thing at all. The motor is weak, the charge does not last for more than one shave.

It takes a half hour to shave, and the shave still sucks. The heads barely cut.

I am going to send his back to Norelco.

I don't know what I will try next. I liked the Cool Skin, but the lotion dispenser is fragile, and I'd rather have a pop up trimmer.

business_name: Philips Sonicare HX5752/02 Essence Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush
product_title: Philips Sonicare HX5752/02 Essence Rechargeable Electric Toothbrush
review_text:
Here are two things Phillips will not tell you about their Sonicare toothbrushes and heads.

1) The collar that holds the toothbrush to the handle will disintegrate in a couple of months. That's what prompted this review, because they would not replace mine after it fell apart two weeks after purchasing a replacement.

They manufacturer these things to disintegrate so you will continue to buy replacements - planned obsolescence. However, I suspect their China supplier is skimping on the plastic specifications and they fall apart in weeks instead of months. (Do you think China would really do that?)

2) UNPLUG your base until you need to charge the toothbrush.  If you charge it up overnight, then unplug the base, the toothbrush will work for four brushings per day for about a month.  Then, when it signals or stops, plug the base in to charge it.

This method will allow your toothbrush to work for five years or longer. If you keep the base plugged in all the time, these NiCad batteries develop memory and will stop functioning after 18 to 24 months.

A bonus, if you travel a lot as I do, you don't have to pack the charger.  Just make sure it's topped off and you're good for a month's vacation.

Received the replacement, but alas, the SAME THING HAPPENED! It's dead, less than 2 weeks after receiving it. I'm applying for a full refund from Sonicare. They say they will give it to me if I fill out a form and ship it back at my expense. They also offered the option of a replacement, but I think this is just a very poor design. Too bad, because when it works, it is great.

business_name: Braun 8000 360 Complete Foil/Cutter Block for Models 8995, 8985, 8975
product_title: Braun 8000 360 Complete Foil/Cutter Block for Models 8995, 8985, 8975
review_text:
If you've been reading any of the reviews here lately you will know the 8000 series foil/cutterblock combo has been replaced with a new combo now called the series 5 Combi 51S.  You will receive this replacement even if the picture on the product page shows "8000 series" as it has been discontinued for over a year.  Braun merged the replacement for the 8000 series (Activator) with the 360 Complete.  This new foil/cutterblock is garbage!  The cutterblock has wide blades, as opposed to the thinner blades of the original 8000 series, which pull your stubble and take MANY passes over your face to shave.  They are prone to premature failure and I have gone through 3(THREE) of these in 6 months!  (I bought one and two were free through Braun after complaining).  All the free replacements in the world weren't making the shaving experience any better.  I longed for the days when my Activator 8595 cut smooth, close, and comfortably.  After all, this shaver had been my favorite for 6 years so far!  I was very close to dumping the whole shaver and moving on when I happened across a reviewer on Amazon who suggested using the 7000 series replacement foil/cutterblock in his review.  It worked PERFECTLY!  The 7000 series replacement looks just like the much coveted original on my 8595 Activator - down to the thinner cutting blades!  It didn't pull my stubble, it cut smooth as butter, and was comfortable: JUST LIKE NEW!  I'd like to thank the original reviewer (James L. Walls "sixtoe") for the very good advice.

***Update: August 10th, 2011***
I hope people are happy with the replacement I recommended.  I sure am!  I just wanted to update the product link for the better replacement: [[ASIN:B001VH6F9G Braun Series 3 Combi 30B Foil and Cutter Replacement Pack (Formerly 4700,7000)]]

***Update: January 13, 2013***
Unfortunately, the Braun 30B Foil and Cutter Replacement Pack is now the same terrible cutter block design as the series 5 (8000 replacement).  I ordered another 30B to replace the one I bought 2.5 years ago and was highly disappointed when the package came.  I will have to do some research to see if any of Braun's other replacements are the good, narrow blade versions.  I have read some reports that the narrow cutting block is available, but without the foil.  If I cannot find a narrow blade replacement I am going to throw in the towel after 8 years of service from this shaver.  Shame on Braun for putting out those ill performing wide blade cutting blocks.  Terrible...

***Update: January 18, 2013***

It appears the highly elusive narrow blade cutter block can be found on the 31S replacement pack.  The unfortunate news is the included foil is not compatible.  Therefore, a replacement foil for the 8000 series/Activator/7000 series/360 Complete would be needed in conjunction with the quality cutter block effectively doubling your cost because it is difficult to find the foil sold by itself.  This would be a combined expense of roughly $55-$60 in order to bring your shaver back to the "like new" shave we all want.  Remember - the "direct" replacement combo for this shaver series will leave you highly disappointed due to the WIDE cutter block which pulls hair and easily nicks skin.  Another facet to influence your decision in spending $60 to refresh your Braun is many of these shavers - due to their age - are in need of new motors and potentially batteries.  The motors gradually slow down with time and I noticed a HUGE difference when I replaced mine 2 years ago.  Now, these motors are almost impossible to find at this point and for me, personally, it is getting to the point of diminished returns.  I hope this post helps you in both informing you of the available narrow cutter block, but also in weighing your decision in either keeping your Braun chugging along or researching a new alternative.

business_name: Philips Sonicare HX3351/02 Xtreme Battery Operated Toothbrush
product_title: Philips Sonicare HX3351/02 Xtreme Battery Operated Toothbrush
review_text:
After owning this toothbrush for a while, I found (as others did), that it drains its batteries in a matter of days.  Improving the seal at the bottom with silicone grease didn't fix the problem, so I took it apart to see what had happened.

The answer seems to be that water had leaked into the main compartment from above, causing corrosion and (presumably) closing a circuit even when the brush was switched off.

This is likely due to my having stood the thing on end, rather than laying it flat.  There's a (leaky) seam that goes around the entire body, and that includes right under the head. Seems like they could have made a much better design with a single solid piece of plastic, with penetrations only for the switch and the batteries.

I still use it, but I have to remove the batteries when I'm done.

review_title: Idea seemed good but practice not so good.
review_text:
I order the Norelco 8060X to replace an old Norelco Cool Shave razor.

PROS - Decent close shave with comfortable grip. Shave lotion filler/dispenser is handy when it works.

CONS - You have to use the razor bent over a sink or in the shower because clippings come out of the head, and they are free to fall from there.  The shave cream is in a bigger package than my previous razor, but it is only two and a half ounces and didn't really last much longer than the package inserts on my old razor.  The razor I received had two defects the rotating razor blades would get stuck in the head and the razor would leak lotion out of the side of the razor when in the dispenser making a mess.

I returned the razor for full refund.

I've kept a towel handy to wipe my the oil off my fingers every time I scratch my scalp, and I've made many trips to the bathroom to get a comb to thoroughly scratch with. Ahhhhhh...relief (for a few seconds).

I've had it on about 10 hours now, and I'm heading in to wash it out. I'll never use it again.

I have a high pain tolerance and I knew there was a risk so I did 2 trial runs that were so-so.

Summary:  It barely removes hair and the price (pain) is the too high.

Also: in fairness, the ball/body wash is actually good, as much as it pains me (literally) to admit that.

Please don’t use the hair removal !!!

business_name: FAIRYDROPS Quattro Mascara
product_title: FAIRYDROPS Quattro Mascara
review_text:
AWFUL.  I was really hoping this mascara would fill the sad, gaping hole left by the discontinuance of Scandal Queen, which was the most perfect, amazing mascara EVER, but nope, the Quattro Film Type mascara is a hugely over-priced disaster.

FIRST:  The design sucks.  The piece in the tube that's supposed to scrape off excess mascara doesn't work well, so the brush pulls out too much mascara with random blobs of it in places.  Then, the brush bristles are waayyy too short, especially for such thick mascara with fibers, so the bristles can't properly pull through your lashes to distribute the mascara and the mascara just kinda blobs on.  I included some photos below to try to show the blobs and how short the bristles are, but I'm not sure if you can tell (black mascara on black bristles is hard to photograph).  Where there aren't blobs on the brush, the mascara lightly coats the corresponding lashes, resulting in a very uneven, lumpy/chunky application.  And you can't even use the brush to try to distribute the mascara through your lashes evenly because there's still too much mascara on it due to the crappy scraper-thing, so if you try to do that, it just globs on more mascara and now you're starting to look like a toddler's puffy paint art project.

SECOND:  Usually you can even out even the clumpiest mascaras using an eyelash comb after the mascara dries a bit.  But not with Quattro because combing it actually pulls off large chunks of the mascara (I think because it's so clumpy/chunky on application, it all sticks together and comes off in pieces).  So the length gets all uneven because the fibers lengthen your lashes, but the combing pulls off some of these fibers.  And the volume becomes patchy and there are literally gaps in the mascara.  There have been a few times where it looked like I had a floating eyelash because black mascara covered half the eyelash, then there was a gap of light-colored natural lash without mascara, and then the mascara continued at the tip of my eyelash.  I've never had anything like this happen with mascara.

THIRD: I don't know this for sure, but I swear my eyelashes got shorter and thinner because of this mascara.  They were very long and thick because I've used GrandeLash and LiLash for a long time, but a couple months after using this Quattro mascara I realized my lashes were noticeably thinner and shorter, even though I was still using LiLash.  I was still using this mascara even though I didn't like it because it's SO expensive, but I stopped using it when I realized my lashes looked thinner/shorter.  It's only been a couple weeks since I stopped using it so it's too soon to know for sure if it's the mascara.

I'm 33 y/o and I've tried A LOT of mascaras, and this is the worst mascara I've EVER used.  Most of the mascaras I haven't liked are because they smudge too easily or don't add enough length or volume, but those problems are fixable by adding a second mascara and/or layering.  But this mascara is in a class by itself--it's not fixable, causes a mess, and possibly hurts your eyelashes.  I don't usually have such strong feelings about a product, but this mascara is THE WORST.

read what else I found:
If you haven’t been using makeup primer, then you’re really missing out.

Whether you wear a full face of makeup everyday or you prefer to keep it simple with BB cream and tinted lip balm, makeup primer is a godsend when trying to combat shine or create a smooth base for foundation.

Yet, many people often skip this step because they believe they don’t really need it, are unsure of how to use it or don’t think it’s worth the investment. However, using primer underneath your makeup will make everything last longer, whether that’s on your skin or in your cosmetics bag. We asked two beauty experts to discuss the ins and outs of primer and why it’s a must-have. Here’s the deal.

Makeup primer is a base for foundation or face makeup that allows it to go on smoother and last longer.

Formulas are available in cream, gel and powder. While moisturizer softens skin, editorial and celebrity makeup artist Stephen Dimmick points out that primer prepares skin for your favorite tinted moisturizer or foundation, giving it something to hold onto so it lasts throughout the day.

Many makeup primers are formulated with silicone-based polymers like dimethicone because of their ultra-smoothing effects. But for those who struggle with cystic acne and other skin conditions, do a patch test or check with a medical professional before use, as there have been reports of allergic reactions to dimethicone.

Physicians Formula’s celebrity makeup artist Joanna Schlip adds that makeup primers can also help smooth any fine lines, wrinkles or large pores. If you are searching for a face primer to help color-correct rosacea or conceal acne spots, Schlip’s go-to is this light green primer as that hue cancels out redness.

Primers are even available just for your eyelids to prevent creasing. “I’d recommend pairing a primer with extra long-wear [eyeshadow or eyeliner] formulas for a look that will really stay put,” says Schlip. If you have oilier eylids, Dimmick advises that you use a mattifying eyelid primer.

Using your fingertips to apply makeup primer allows you to really work the product into your skin.

Schlip thinks it’s best to apply primer with fingertips for areas larger than a quarter. “If only using for small areas, I’d recommend a brush. I like to use a concealer or lip brush for this,” she said. This spot-treat technique gives the look of a more natural finish, according to Schlip.

Taking this routine a step further, Dimmick considers the process “an exercise for the face.” He explains that massaging primer onto skin with fingertips helps “to get the blood flowing underneath.” We’ll consider that the next time we’re meditating while putting on makeup.

Primer is a life-saver for getting your makeup to stay-put in extreme weather.

If you live, visit or plan on traveling anywhere that experiences hot and humid or cold and dry temperatures, Schlip suggests having primer handy to help your makeup wear longer. However, Dimmick advocates for using primer year-round. “No matter what the weather is like outside, this extra step will save you a lot of time and effort.”

Primer can even be worn on its own.
Love the fresh no-makeup look but want to look a bit more polished than when you first woke up? Primer is your answer. The product can be worn on your eyelids and double as a light eyeshadow, or it can serve as a lighter alternative to foundation.

review_text:
I love snail slime. I have been reading about it for a while and am so glad I pulled the trigger to purchase it. I get occasional acne and scar easily. After two uses I saw a profound improvement in my skin. Nothing works that fast.I am a believer and am buying up all the slime I can find. The use of snail slime to improve skin dates back to ancient Greece, where Hippocrates, the famous physician, reportedly prescribed crushed snails and sour milk as a way to rid the skin of inflammation. In more recent times, the use of snail creams started when Chilean farmers who handled snails for the French market noticed their skin was visibly smoother. Nowadays, it is the secreted slime discovered by these farmers that is harvested to produce snail cream, not crushed up snails.
How the Slime Works
When snails are agitated, they excrete a thick fluid as a means to protect themselves. It may sound odd to use something like that on your skin, but remember that humans and most other animals also excrete oils as a way to protect their skin. In fact, the oil your body excretes to moisturize your skin is made up of lipids, sebum oil, and dead skin cells. As a snail protects itself, the slime that is excreted from its body is packed with nutrients like hyaluronic acid, glycoprotein enzymes, antimicrobial and copper peptides, and proteoglycans. All of these nutrients are already commonly added to beauty products and are thought to provide many benefits to skin.
The science behind snail slime as a viable beauty cream is mostly derived from lab studies where the effects of the slime have been tested on a variety of cell cultures. In these studies, research suggests that snail slime will stimulate the production of elastin and collagen, increase fibronectin protein production, and stimulate increased proliferation of fibroblasts. While all of these traits could be beneficial for skin, there have yet to be significant cosmetic trials or research into how snail slime actually affects the skin, and how long those effects last. In fact, there haven’t been any significant clinical trials on how a specific beauty product containing snail slime actually works on this skin – just the slime itself.
One of the main difficulties in conducting clinical trials on the benefits of snail slime is that the market has not fully figured out how to guarantee the results of testing. After all, if snail creams are to be effective, then the slime has to have a consistent concentration of the various chemical compounds, but this is difficult to guarantee. Because the success of trials leans heavily on the quality of snail extract used, the concentration of slime and the way it is excreted and processed, test results can sometimes be misleading. Some companies that manufacture snail creams do choose to keep a steady supply of their own snails so they can better regulate the extraction and formulation of the slime.

A month later and my KP looks exactly the same - I've attached an AFTER picture to this review. Check the other 1 star reviews on both products - this company is paying for good reviews - look how many people got free product for their review.

This is basically a rebadged pumice scrub that you can buy at the drugstore - check the ingredients, it's right there - pumice. There are no specific ingredients to help with KP, just some essential oils that you'd find in most scrubs.

Just like the cream, this product is for sale anywhere besides Amazon - you can see that because they've printed the Amazon barcode itself right on the label. There's no real UPC. This product can't even be sold in stores because of it's labeling. Just another marketing company relabeling a basic scrub for KP. Don't fall for the new products like this one that pop up periodically - go with something that's been around for a long time.

review_text:
So disappointed with this juicer. I did so much research on juicers, as I didnt have enough to buy an Omega,Champion or Hurom. I really liked this ones write up and wanted it to be true so when it came up on amazon lightening deal I took the chance. WORST DECISION EVER.

This juicer at first un boxing seems very sturdy. However, while the auger housing where you feed the fruit locks in tightly but the auger doesn't. The screen also nice quality, fits tightly and the end locks on well. Ok, cool. It looks nice.

The chute is small in diameter so you have to cut up things pretty small. So prep takes a while.
The write up says you can juice a cup in a minute. So I turn the machine on and it isn't very loud until you start feeding it. It chomps up everything but shakes the whole feeding/pour out piece and makes this squeeking noise while shaking. It takes about 8 minutes to make a cup of juice not 1 as stated in the write up for the juicer.
It is pretty mediocre with any leafy stuff...
You can do the roll up with kale or spinach and try to follow up with something more juicy like an apple but it usually ends up clogging or getting wrapped around the auger. Kale you def have to remove that big stem in the middle.
Ironically, it comes with a little recipe book and gives a recipe for celery juice.
I truly can't even imagine how long or if this machine could even make a cup of celery juice. Ive added some all 3 times Ive juiced and cut it into little 1/4 inch squares. Teeny tiny. And it still clogs the screen after a few minutes.
Juicing beets I found that I coukd very easily re-juice the pulp it comes out so wet.

Ok. So overall, today was my 3rd time making a batch of juice and my yield was less than last time and the significantly less than the first.
I've used the exact same number and kinds of fruit/veg.
So, inconclusion, it's inexpensive for a reason. I really hoped this would be a better juicer.
Perhaps I got a dud.
Returning this unit asap and will continue to research or continue to save to buy an Omega or Champion.

review_text:
I've tried the milk of magnesia, baking soda w/cornstarch, white vinegar wiped on and left to dry. They have all left me a musty mess. But I seen this deodorant, seen the price, I was like , ugh, for $11 this better work. I received my risky bet in the mail this past Thursday. I showered and followed the directions of letting it warm up in my pits before spreading. Wasn't gritty. A faint starchy scent but barely noticeable unless you stuck your nose in it. I freshened up the next day WITHOUT washing my armpits or reapplying. I was home doing nothing and I wanted to put this thru its paces. Saturday morning I smelled a faint scent of armpit and i was like okay. Showered and reapplied. Today is Sunday, 83 degrees, 60% humidity, 400 lbs of hot sweaty body after a morning shower and reapplication. Before i get back in the shower, I had to leave this review, I AM NOT MUSTY. Armpits are wet, but not stinky. I have found my deodorant before this hot southern summer hits, and im feeling like rainbows and sunshine!

UPDATE: After a month of use Im gonna have to say NOOOOOOO! My armpits are a peeling sore mess, after showering i have peeled skin falling from my towel when i dry off. I dont know what happened, around the 7th of May things went down hill, im sore, peeling, MY ARMPITS ARE DARK. Umm i got this because baking soda was usually the offender for this,and this product supposedly has less than others. As im typing this im two weeks into healing and my armpits are STILL hurting, its healing, just slow as hell. Im literally using ogx scalp treatment with tea tree and witch hazel to ease the pain and help heal which is actually working go figure. Maybe this can be for someone else, but i think im going back to regular deodorant.

I sweat a LOT, especially when stressed, which is often, and I cannot use any products with metals or toxins on my skin, or else my skin becomes inflamed and irritated. As far as longevity, this organic deodorant lasts longer than all of the others I have tried (Native, Tom's, etc.). I have to reapply once a day if I sweat a lot and after about 3 or 4 hours I can smell  my BO a little bit, hence the re-application. Overall, excellent product, best organic deodorant in my opinion.  I don't use any other brand.

product_title: TOUCH IN SOL Flawless Skin Top Coat 1.18 fl.oz. (35ml) - One Step Makeup (Nourishing Ampoule + High Adhesive Makeup Base + Fresh Silky Powder), Moisturizing High Coverage Foundation (#1 Light)
review_title: high coverage, invisibly lightweight feel, long-wearing
review_text:
The key points of this foundation:

-A thin, weightless, almost invisible veil that doesn't suffocate skin
-High coverage in a few drops
-Extra Long-wearing due to volatile carriers (i.e. like a L'Oreal infallible)

Because it's so thin, it doesn't have a lot of hydration so if your skin is extra dry, be sure to prime and moisturize first.
However it provides flawless, high coverage to mask all blemishes and discolorations. Long-wearing even in high humidity.

The only thing i don't like is that you have to shake it before use, which is a small qualm. It comes in a dropper style GLASS bottle (not plastic!).

I wasn't able to great "beach waves", nope, just regular curls. But since it has dual rotation, you can make both sides of your hair match!

It is easy to figure out so I didn't have any trouble with that. It seems like high quality and was presented in the package well. But I wouldn't buy it for full price. Maybe if it was on sale. review_text:
I have pale/porcelain skin and I tend to burn easily.
Aloe is always a great option for sunburns but a lot of them seem to be so sticky because the actual plant meat is sticky.
This aloe is wonderful.
At first it feels like regular aloe but as you rub it into your skin it absorbs and isn’t sticky.
It’s nice being able to apply it before bed and not have my pajamas stick to me all night.
After I burn I apply this aloe and by morning (if the burn isn’t too bad) it’s faded into a light tan!!!

** Thank you so much for taking the time to read my review.
I hope the information that I've provided helps to make your decision a little easier.

review_text:
This pack of 16 nail files from Keiby Citom is a great value.

I started doing dip nails at home, and the worst part is getting off the old manicure. I have to file off the layers of top coat, which can take a while if I don’t have a good file. I prefer a glass file for actually shaping my nails, but they’re not good for removing layers of polish.

Using one of these files, I had the top coat filed off all my nails in less than ten minutes. The 100 grit side is perfect. I actually asked a nail tech friend what I should use, and she told me 100 grit.

The files come in a zipper seal plastic bag that can be used to store them.

The edges of the files aren’t sharp. I’m talking about the edges that touch your skin; sometimes these can be sharp, especially on pro files, and need to be seasoned to prevent cuts. No problems with that here.

review_text:
I am always interested in trying new skincare innovations, products and brands.  I am new to the Laloirelle brand and  was intrigued by the description of this Luminous Face Oil.  I'd used different face oils in the past with varying success.  I have oily skin in parts (T zone) and sensitive skin.

This Luminous Face Oil combines several high quality antioxidants to help moisten and brighten the skin.  I found the face oil was not quickly absorbed into the skin.  I would prefer to use this at night because of the time it takes for the oil to be absorbed.  I did wake up with well hydrated skin. Considering the high cost of this face oil, I had expected it to standout. I may have to use it for an extended time before I feel or see results.

I did not experience any redness, irritation or sensitivity.

review_text:

I have have used several Murad products over the years, and this is in line with their other high-quality products.

review_text:
VINE CUSTOMER REVIEWS give a far better commentary on the ease of use and desirability of this product.  Strangely, these reviews are quite far down on the list.  Had I scrolled to the bottom of the 1st page & then clicked on "more review" I could have been aware of these reviews and  would read these FIRST!
This product is AWFUL.
The applicator spews powder all over the place.  I should have worn a painter's drop cloth when using or been nude!  But, the powder won't just shower off!
The stencils are stiff and will not lie flat on the curve of my brow bone, clearly showing that I never learned to color within the lines.  Leaving me with Grouch Marx brows like one other reviewer had.  I especially liked another reviewer's comment about not being able to get both brows the same and she then closely resemble Mrs. Potato Head.  YEP,
This product is sooooo NOT Goof Proof.  Even having someone else apply the powder proved DIFFICULT and oh so unattractive.
When the description sounds too good to be true . . . then is probably is!
Save your money and time.  A pencil will NEVER throw the dust this powder applicator does.

I'd definitely check out some of their other offerings.

review_text:
I've had my Braun 8595 for 5 years.  I LOVED MY BRAUN!!! It was worth every penny of the original purchase price, and the cost of previous replacement foils.  I went to buy my third set of replacement foils to discover the Model 8000 Activator, the original shaver foil and cutter block, had been discontinued and replaced with the 360* Complete, so I bought that.  Braun had been great, and never let me down before.

I have fairly tough skin, but this new head caused horrible, painful razor burn.  It's the worst on the neck, but it causes it everywhere.  Rather than simply cutting the hair as I moved the razor across my face like the original foils had, the new one grabs my skin and hair and drags them along before finally cutting.  As a result of the painful dragging of the skin and hair before eventually cutting it, the shave is not as close since it isn't cutting the hair straight on as the razor with the original foils did.  Now it hurts to get a lousy shave.

Braun must want us to buy the new Pulsonic, but I'm not falling for it.  They'll just mess up the foil and cutter again once a newer razor comes out.

business_name: Emjoi eRase e60-60 Tweezer Head Epilator
product_title: Emjoi eRase e60-60 Tweezer Head Epilator
review_title: Cheap Plastic Wind-Up Toy Masquerading As An Epilator
review_text:
I have been a long-time user of Emjoi epilators. In fact, I've only ever used Emjoi epilators because they worked well for me. So, when my last one died recently, I was excited to see this model touting 60 tweezers instead of the measly 36 tweezers on my old Emjoi. I am not an especially hairy person, but I love how epilating makes my legs, arms, and underarms so much smoother than shaving. The main drawback is that it takes longer to epilate because the head is usually so small and you have to repeatedly go over the same area to make sure you get all the hair out. I was hoping that having almost twice as many tweezers working would make the job go faster. Apparently, I was wrong in that assumption.

The first thing that struck me with the eRase was the size. It is tiny! (See my pictures comparing it to my old Emjoi Soft Caress) I have medium-sized hands, and the eRase is a slippery little bugger to hold onto for an extended period of time. It doesn't help that the whole unit is made of smooth plastic with no bumpy or grippy parts to help your grip. I ended up having to sort of pinch it with my fingertips the whole time I used it. Very ergonomically bad for your hands.

The other main thing that I noticed was that the whole thing - other than the tweezers - seems to be made of plastic. You can see in my pictures that even the gears that drive the tweezer heads are plastic. I can't imagine this epilator lasts long with plastic gears. It's really no better than a little high-powered wind-up toy (it even kind of sounds like one when it's running).

As for the hair removal part - the whole reason why I would buy an epilator - it was mediocre at best. It did not save me any time over my 36-tweezer model. The eRase is so tiny that it didn't cover any more surface area, and the design is flawed so that the two heads seem to get in the way of each other and actually pull out less hair per pass than my old model. I also felt like it was just ripping the top part of the hairs rather than removing them from the roots. I noticed, too, that it did not remove the fine hairs on my underarms and legs very well at all. review_title: Works great if you want a frizzy mess
review_text:
I should have listened to the negative reviews. I just figured the people that didn't like this curling iron didn't know what they were doing, didn't follow the directions, etc. and that was why they didn't get the results they desired. After all, if you look at all the videos on youtube, it looks so easy to get beautiful spiral curls. I'm not the most skilled at styling my hair, but I can do a pretty decent job with a blow dryer, hot rollers or a regular curling iron, so I figured I'd be able to manage this Bed Head curler just fine with a little practice.

Boy, was I wrong! Despite following all the instructions on various youtube videos, all I got was a frizzy mess. Remember that episode of Friends where Monica went on vacation and there was so much humidity that her hair kept getting bigger and frizzier? That's what my hair ended up looking like (and my hair is naturally stick straight). Also, the glove did very little to protect against the heat - after just a couple seconds, it was too hot for me to touch the curling iron.

I will go back to using a regular curling iron or hot rollers when I want to add a little curl. I'm sorry I wasted my money on this thing.

product_title: Bouclème Curl Defining Gel, Medium Hold, Moisturizing Serum - 10.1 fl oz
review_text:
My hair has always been very easily weighted down and now with that rough, protein overload texture it has been even harder to put product in my hair. I was using the Boucleme hair cream during the winter months, but with spring and summer coming I needed something that would moisturize without being greasy or heavy and this was it! Right out of the shower I used this on damp hair and it air dried perfect! It did create a cast, but my curls formed with very little frizz and it gave them a nice shine! Once it dried, I threw my hair over my head and gave it a little shake and the cast went away fairly quickly.

The part when I knew this worked well was when I slept in my usual pineapple, the next morning my hair still looked good and my curls were intact! I highly recommend to anyone looking for a light gel with really good hold.

review_text: These don’t feel at all like microfiber cloths, more like really soft, thin, fuzzy blankets.
